name: Cisco Systems, Inc.
operational_role: Primary provider of high-security networking hardware, encrypted switches, routers, and server infrastructure powering the core communication grids of the Israel Defense Forces and Ministry of Defense.
government_liaisons: Israel Defense Forces (Lotem / C4I Telecommunications Division)
documented_activities: Supplier of core optical networking hardware and secure telecommunication exchanges for the IDF's dedicated military communications backbone (the 'Prism' fiber-optic network). Cisco equipment links military headquarters in the Kirya (Tel Aviv) with tactical brigade command posts, southern military outposts bordering Gaza, and field command vehicles during active military operations.
documented_consequences: Maintains the high-bandwidth, redundant data routing essential for the transmission of live drone video feeds, battlefield sensor data, and automated targeting coordination across military units operating in Gaza.
